_doc: Agency seals harvested from the hand-made golden reference. These are inherited DESIGN, not evidence: a seal identifies the buying agency and carries no claim. Vendor and competitor wordmarks are deliberately NOT catalogued: they are client-specific and hardcoding them would put one client's competitors in another client's report.

provenance.method: sha1-deduped inline data URIs, each keyed to the agency named on the card that carried it
